_shape.note: A scene template is DATA, the same way a caption template is. It says how many slots, how long each holds, how it moves and how it hands over to the next. The media is whatever the operator drops in. Nothing here names a particular image, so one template serves every client.
_shape.slot_seconds: How long each piece of media holds, before the overlap with the next is taken off.
_shape.transition: One of ffmpeg's xfade types. There are 58 built in; these use the ones that suit a design-led client rather than a gaming channel. Avoid `dissolve`: despite the name it is a per-pixel random-threshold dither, not a gentle cross-fade, and the noise it makes is uncompressible. The same 11-second reel was 6.24MB with dissolve and 0.54MB with fade.
_shape.motion: Ken Burns per slot, cycled if there are more slots than entries. Alternating in and out stops a row of stills reading as one continuous drift.
_shape.fit: cover crops to fill the frame; contain letterboxes onto the pad colour. Architecture and interiors are shot wide, so cover is usually right and contain is for a drawing nobody wants cropped.
_shape.duration: n * slot_seconds - (n - 1) * transition.seconds. The template's own arithmetic, not a fixed length.

project-reveal.name: Project reveal
project-reveal.description: Slow push into each image, soft horizontal wipe between
project-reveal.best_for: Architecture and interiors, where the work carries the frame

catalogue.name: Catalogue
catalogue.description: Held frames, straight cuts, no movement at all
catalogue.best_for: Product and furniture, where a push would read as a sales reel

archive-plate.name: Archive plate
archive-plate.description: The whole object on a plain ground, a long slow push
archive-plate.best_for: Scans, drawings and anything that must not be cropped

detail-push.name: Detail push
detail-push.description: Hard push into the detail of each frame
detail-push.best_for: The zoom reveal: wide view, into the detail, land the fact

contact-sheet.name: Contact sheet
contact-sheet.description: Quick, even, a slight drift. Many images in a short run
contact-sheet.best_for: A body of work, a collection, an event in one post

quiet-fade.name: Quiet fade
quiet-fade.description: Long holds, long dissolves, almost no movement
quiet-fade.best_for: Hospitality and anything that should feel unhurried
